purpose: Photographic concept component for the Element board assembly story; never a personal reading.

steps.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent photographic component for an educational fragrance-kit assembly website.
Primary request: ONE single unused oil blotting sheet, a very thin blue-grey matte membrane, completely flat and rectangular with a precise width-to-height ratio of 1.6:1.
Scene/backdrop: genuine fully transparent alpha background, isolated cutout. No surface or background of any kind.
Style/medium: convincing close-up product photography of a real delicate laboratory blotting membrane, subtle fine paper-like fibres and very restrained natural tonal variation. The whole sheet remains readable and substantially opaque.
Composition/framing: orthographic straight-on front view, camera perpendicular to the sheet. Horizontal long edges parallel to the image edges, vertical sides exactly vertical, no perspective skew, no curl, no folded corners, no rotation. Show the complete sheet centered with modest transparent margins; it should occupy around 88% of the image width. The subject itself is exactly a 1.6:1 rectangle.
Lighting/mood: soft even diffused light, quiet and material-realistic, no glossy highlights and no cast shadow extending outside the sheet.
Colour palette: muted cool blue-grey slate, approximately #667b87, with a light tactile matte surface. This is a concept component, not a measurement result.
Constraints: one membrane only. No printed graphics, no dots, no stains, no oil spot, no calibration marks, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no instruments, no package, no hands, no surrounding board. No shiny icon styling, no extrusion, no decorative outline. Preserve real alpha transparency outside the membrane.

Edit target: the attached blue-grey blotting membrane only. Keep its photographic matte fibre texture, cool slate blue-grey colour, thin flat material, genuine transparent background and lack of markings. Correct only the membrane's silhouette/proportions and any edge colour artifact.
The final SINGLE membrane must be a 1.6:1 horizontal rectangle: a physical laboratory sheet 160 millimetres wide and 100 millimetres tall. The current sheet is much too long and too short. INCREASE ITS HEIGHT substantially to give a visible rectangle with width exactly 1.6 times height. Do not just put the existing narrow rectangle in a larger canvas. Camera remains perpendicular and orthographic: four straight edges, all corners square, no angle or perspective, no bends or folds. Frame this corrected 160-by-100 sheet centrally and nearly fill a 1.6:1 landscape canvas, with modest even transparent margins on all four sides. The object should occupy approximately 85% of both canvas width AND canvas height.
Keep the membrane fully opaque enough to see the quiet natural fibrous texture. Outside is real alpha transparency. Remove any bright blue/cyan edge fringe: edges are clean natural blue-grey antialiasing only. No exterior cast shadow. No shiny highlights, labels, printed graphics, calibration marks, spots, text, numbers, logos, instruments or board. This remains an unused concept component, not a personal reading.

Edit target: this single blue-grey membrane image. Keep its same matte photographic material, fibrous texture, muted slate blue-grey colour, straight horizontal edges, same width and front-on camera. Increase ONLY the sheet height by about 15 percent. Its width must be exactly 1.6 times its height. The visible blue-grey rectangle currently spans about x=65 to1520 and y=99 to891 on a1585x992 canvas; keep its horizontal span and move the top edge up to about y=42 and the bottom edge down to about y=951. This gives a1455-pixel-wide and909-pixel-tall rectangle, the required1.6:1 geometry. Keep modest even transparent margin around the complete sheet. Do not crop the sheet. It is flat, opaque, thin and unused, with zero printed marks, text, stains, graphics or numbers. Correct transparency cleanly: ONLY the rectangular sheet has opacity; all surrounding pixels are fully alpha-transparent. Remove all detached flecks and ALL bright cyan or blue fringing, leaving a clean natural grey-blue edge with narrow antialiasing. No exterior shadows or glow. No other objects or board. Preserve genuine alpha transparency.

preparation: Lossless PNG recompression only. Generated pixel dimensions, RGBA pixels and alpha retained exactly; no crop, resizing or colour editing.
alignment_note: Use substantial alpha bounds (>8/255) to align the visible sheet. Very low-alpha exterior flecks make raw alpha>0 bounds broader. Place in the exact board target rectangle; the generated visible ratio differs slightly from 1.6.
bounds_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right and bottom exclusive; alpha threshold means alpha > threshold
